## What changed and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Visual change: screenshot attached and `npm run test:visual` reviewed
- [ ] Database change: existing codes, tracking links and sessions are preserved (migration noted)
- [ ] Anything new that is public, personal or sensitive has limits, escaping and a deletion path
- [ ] README, `.env.example` and CHANGELOG updated if behavior or settings changed
